issues.on_page: Bond Fund column p4: General Government 3,484; Principal Payments 250,000; Interest and Fiscal Charges 15,318; Capital Outlay 925,175 (total 1,193,977)
issues.issue: The Bond Fund budget schedule (p7) prints a single 'Disbursements' 1,193,977. The statement's Bond Fund column shows it is 77% capital outlay (925,175) and only 22% debt service (265,318). The extractor's own review note says capital outlay is dominant, but it recorded debt service. Under the rule for a line that mixes categories, the category should be capital outlay, the dominant one (detail_category stays 'not itemized').
issues.resolved: category capital outlay (925,175 of 1,193,977 is capital outlay per p4)
